info.about: Alice: Madness Returns is a 2011 action-adventure game developed by Spicy Horse and released by Electronic Arts for Windows, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.
info.trivia: Electronic Arts started work on the sequel in 2007 after the original American McGee's Alice had become a cult classic.
info.why: Despite mixed reviews it has kept a cult following as an underrated favourite since its release.
